content.title: 2026 Masters Saturday channel: TV schedule for Round 3 at Augusta National
content.text: Hoping to watch the 2026 Masters on TV Saturday? We've got you covered. Getty Images You’re reading our Masters viewer’s guide for Round 3. To see complete TV coverage and streaming schedules for Sunday’s final round of the 2026 Masters, click here.———The 2026 Masters continues on Saturday with Round 3 at Augusta National. CBS will provide TV coverage of all the third-round action, but there are plenty of other opporunities to watch as well. Keep reading for a complete 2026 Masters Saturday TV schedule and streaming information.What channel is Masters Round 3 on?ESPN aired TV coverage for Thursday’s opening round and Friday’s second round, but for Saturday’s third round, coverage will switch to the Masters longtime TV home: CBS.CBS’ Masters Saturday broadcast will start at 2 p.m. ET and last five hours, finishing at 7 p.m. ET. But there’s even more Masters coverage available online.As they did last year, Paramount+ will provide two hours of early Saturday streaming coverage beginning at 12 p.m. ET. You can also watch the early coverage (and CBS’ broadcast) for free on Masters.com and the Masters App.Additional viewing options will be provided online via Masters.com, the Masters App, Paramount+, the ESPN App and more, including featured group and featured hole coverage.Below you will find more detailed information on how to watch the third round of the 2026 Masters.Masters Saturday TV scheduleCBS will air Saturday’s third round of the 2026 Masters on TV from 2-7 p.m. ET.Masters Saturday streaming scheduleYou can stream Saturday’s third round of the 2026 Masters online on
